note: In-race LAP COUNTER digit. The counter is flag + digit + "/N"; only the digit is read here. Same model as clock_grid.json — columns are {x, tilt} with x at the BOTTOM row. Seeded from a real frame (ink at x 54..74, y 8..45 inside the anchor); place it exactly at /deltagrid (target: lap). Reading the digit replaces correlating whole counter images, where a 7-segment "5" is a strict SUBSET of "6" and matches it perfectly.
digitsNote: The '1' in these counters is CENTERED, not drawn on the right like the clock's. The two central verticals were already in the segment model and used by no digit, so this only turns them on — nothing else competes for them. Overrides merge over detection.sevenSegment.
